verses.21:11: وَكَمۡ قَصَمۡنَا مِن قَرۡيَةࣲ كَانَتۡ ظَالِمَةࣰ وَأَنشَأۡنَا بَعۡدَهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

meaning: The root قصم denotes breaking something so that it is severed or shattered. Classical lexicons explicitly connect the Quranic قَصَمْنَا with destroying by breaking or crushing.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
